headline: Change at the Top of Rubi Capital: Yaakov Nitzan to Serve as Sole CEO
summary: Rubi Capital is canceling its joint management model, with Yaakov Nitzan becoming sole CEO. Founding partner Gershon Shapira will step back from day-to-day management and remain a director and shareholder.
why: Rubi Capital is an Israeli investment house, and changes in leadership structure can affect its strategy and client relationships.
